scripts.build:extension: pnpm --filter coreply-app build && pnpm --filter coreply-browser-extension build
scripts.zip:extension: pnpm --filter coreply-app build && pnpm --filter coreply-browser-extension zip
scripts.run:extension: pnpm --filter coreply-app build && pnpm --filter coreply-browser-extension dev
scripts.run:android:rc: pnpm --filter coreply-wrapper build --mode development && variant=rc pnpm --filter coreply-app run:android
scripts.run:android:web: pnpm --filter coreply-wrapper build --mode development && variant=web pnpm --filter coreply-app run:android
